newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end mixed in lackluster trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end mixed in lackluster trading.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed for the second consecutive day in lackluster trading dominated by rises in tobacco.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index edged up 0.08 percent to 18,420.77 on below average trading volume of one billion pesos. Bogota's IBB price index slipped 0.14 percent to 1,204.54 on volume of 1.6 billion.
Dealers said the light market action could be explained by investors holding out for impending first half financial reports.
Cigarette maker Coltabaco led the day's gains, finishing up 2.43 percent to 4,200 in Bogota, and up 1.82 percent to 4,175 in Medellin.
Investors sought Coltabaco for its strong holdings in fellow Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate companies, traders said.
Banco Ganadero, the country's largest bank in terms of assets, pushed the Bogota market downward, slipping 0.75 percent to 397 on 79 million pesos traded. The bank was not traded in Medellin.
